candidates.change_summary: Remove the hasNoBalance modifier entirely so that airdrop can be called multiple times by the same address, changing tokenBalance after the first call.
Change the addition amount from 20 to 21 so that tokenBalance[msg.sender] increases by a different amount.

Replace the overflow check with a tautology require(true) so that the function still executes, but mutation checks if the behavior changes (it won't in normal execution, but this is a structural mutant).
Remove the unlock statement (_locked = false) at the end of _nonReentrant, making the lock permanent, which prevents any subsequent airdrop from changing tokenBalance after the first call.
Change the required token name in supportsToken to a different string so that the modifier rejects the call, preventing tokenBalance from increasing.
Replace '+=' with '=' so that balance is set to 20 instead of increased by 20.
Delete the assignment 'tokenBalance[msg.sender] += 20;' so the balance does not change.
Replace the require condition with 'true' to always pass (removes overflow check).
Delete the overflow check require statement.
Remove the hasNoBalance modifier's requirement so airdrop can be called on existing balances.
Replace the require with 'require(true);' to disable token support check.
Delete the require statement so supportsToken check is bypassed.
Remove the nonReentrant lock require so reentrant calls are allowed.
Replace 'require(!_locked);' with 'require(true);' to disable reentrancy lock.
Remove both lock state changes so the lock is never toggled.
